alerts.summary: The maintainers of the PHP programming language on Wednesday issued an advisory announcing an upcoming security release that addresses critical flaws. The release is scheduled for November 19, 2026, between 2 and 2:30 p.m. UTC. "These releases are part of PHP's regular four-week release cycle and will address security vulnerabilities affecting all supported PHP versions," the maintainers said.

alerts.title: Ukraine, FBI arrest ransomware gang members tied to $40M in ransoms
alerts.summary: Ukrainian authorities, working with the FBI, have arrested four suspected members of an international ransomware organization linked to more than $40.5 million in ransom payments from at least 28 companies worldwide. [...]

alerts.title: Critical Apache Roller RCE Flaw Under Active Exploitation, No Authentication Required
alerts.summary: A critical security flaw in Apache Roller, an open-source, Java-based blogging platform, has come under active exploitation in the wild, according to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-129448 (CVSS score: 9.8), is a case of unauthenticated deserialization in the XML-RPC endpoint that could lead to remote code execution.
